conflict_and_failure_rules.LINK_race: IHK BUSY serializes IHK capsule use, but backend LINK may have a pending ticket. Revalidate actual link busy/gate/second fields under slots and freeze them atomically with control installation; do not widen existing LINK irreversible semantics.
conflict_and_failure_rules.close_race: Before transfer revalidation rejects closed/cancelled delivery. After transfer close may cancel/mark owner but cannot consume pending response or remove the exact pinned parent/child entry. No parent-death retry authority is created.
conflict_and_failure_rules.duplicates: Same already-parked delivery returns busy/idempotent retained status; never takes another Response or increments another pin. Foreign worker/serial/request/key/epoch/control refuses with no ownership transfer.
conflict_and_failure_rules.failure_retention: No response-restore retry after uncertain ownership move. If restoring to Mailbox is ever added, it must precede publication-pin release, be exact once, and respect actual restore method potentially moving response before later cancellation error.

exact_order: Under slots, discover actual delivered request and snapshot full existing child identity/epoch/carrier tuple. Keep only scalar immutable snapshot in synchronous stack ticket; move no Response and expose no payload pointer yet.

Release slots. IHK resolver authenticates connection and obtains strict actual pending stage0 BUSY claim; clone/pin actual owner/capsule/payload. No IHK table lock spans provider continuation or MM/foreign calls.

Scoped continuation reacquires slots and revalidates EVERYTHING from discovery including real delivery, child state, open/no-busy LINK, cancellation and control uniqueness. A concurrent LINK/close/cancel or stale epoch causes refusal before transfer.

Preallocate fallible durable-control storage before transfer; reserve actual extra parent publication/slot pin under slots, then take SAME fresh response via actual Mailbox method and atomically install durable ChildFork.control that owns response ticket, exact request/worker/serial/identity/epoch and Remote/parent retention. Roll back exact provisional pin on pre-transfer failure only; no general decrement authority.

While slots is still held, new control marker must freeze all LINK admissions/finish/publication and conflicting controls; fork_ingress_pending alone freezes ordinary Mailbox return but does NOT freeze LINK. No marker/phase is itself receipt authority.

End every payload/descriptor/shared-reference borrow and release slots before callback returns. No pointer to IHK scope, raw claim, stack ticket, mutable payload writer, or temporary descriptor is stored in ChildFork.control.

IHK claim.restore only after successful ownership installation. If restore or later structural check fails, retain/quarantine both pending IHK owner and durable backend control/response/parent pin; never drop ticket, restore normal publication or free original payload.

PreRETURN hook returns EBUSY on parked state and does not invoke normal RETURN_SYSCALL. Original positive RET and initial payload capsule remain untouched; no receipt bytes, MM revoke, root destruction, finalACK or pin release occur.
functional_scope: Functional OS/apps and Rust delivery: one real unpublished fresh-response ownership transition; no provider activation or receipt/native proof.

minimum_distinct_interface.descriptor_fields_required: version/bytes/reserved; full backend-derived ForkIdentityV1; exact existing provider epoch; fresh control worker/delivery/cpu; exact carrier physical/root/length/nonce metadata; no borrowed pointer that survives callback.
minimum_distinct_interface.park_callback: Only SAME trusted backend continuation and stack ticket under scoped IHK claim; existing payload context may be read-borrowed to validate owner/physical/immutable descriptor. No mutable writer needed or permitted in this park-only phase; no claim/payload/reference pointer escapes.
minimum_distinct_interface.provider_prepare_arguments: Existing live application connection plus worker, serial, cpu and observed launcher return value; actual provider derives the matched Delivered Request and ChildFork identity.
minimum_distinct_interface.resolver_scope: Actual registered SMP provider derives descriptor. Genuine IHK export authenticates live parent connection/OS/provider callback closure and pins every current callback/module/OS object throughout synchronous return. Child context is looked up by exact backend key then revalidated under IHK claim; never caller-supplied bare context.
minimum_distinct_interface.return_mapping: Internal NotControl passes ordinary return. Durable Parked maps to -EBUSY before standard RETURN invocation; status0 inside a scoped callback only reports construction completion, never guest RET0 or revoke permission. Errors remain exact errors, not allow-legacy-publication fallback.
minimum_distinct_interface.semantics: New internal typed callback path, not aliases or reinterpretation of LINK/ACK descriptors/callbacks. Exact FFI layout/registration version and size assertions belong to actual upcoming source, not invented fixed binary offsets in this decision.

failures: Wrong generation/key/epoch/physical or stale delivery refuses before move
Duplicate or concurrent LINK/busy/SEALED control cannot create second owner/pin
Parent close/cancel race before transfer refuses; after transfer retains exact owner
Post-install claim.restore failure quarantines and retains response/pins with no legacy publish
Existing negative refusal and ordinary clone/LINK/ACK behavior remain unchanged unless matching private new control path
next_focused_check_after_actual_source_a.positive: Actual delivered selector2 response plus existing real IHK pending capsule/claim -> exact durable backend control owner, publication frozen, IHK prior PENDING restored, original RET/payload unchanged, hook refuses normal publication. This is owner parking only, not successful revoke.
next_focused_check_after_actual_source_a.scope: One actual current private owner-construction path and targeted failures only; no38/60/old9 replay, no new guest/root/compile by reviewer.

selected_findings.finding: Actual stage0 clones pending owner/capsule/payload and marks BUSY without reserving new completion receipt or setting attempted. Generic stage0 also permits phases too broad for this new operation; strict wrapper validation required.
This may reserve durable completion receipt, return already-completed, and set entry.attempted=true. It is not a validation-only primitive and must not underpin the park-only transition.

Actual methods move the SAME Response only for exact live worker/serial/full Request with no completion/kernel/service/cancellation. take sets fork_ingress_pending, so normal Mailbox return refuses it. Caller must retain publication/parent ownership. Drop leaks response rather than freeing uncertain storage; that alone is not durable recovery.

restore rechecks actual exact BUSY epoch/key/owner and restores previous phase. Unrestored active Drop quarantines the pending owner; post-park errors must preserve durable control/response/parent ownership.

Actual hook runs after descriptor/worker delivery decode but before LINK/ACK helpers and standard invoke(RETURN_SYSCALL). Ordinary returns must pass unchanged. Parked control returns EBUSY without consuming original delivery; syscall scalar -95 from current launcher is not ownership or phase proof.

IHK_required: Prior phase exactly FORK_PROVIDER_PENDING(1), reject phase0/BUSY/QUARANTINED/HOST_REVOKED
Exact identity+childcontext+provider epoch, actual owner/capsule/payload present and stable under exclusive BUSY claim
No host_revoked/guest_released/final_published state; initialized actual payload/capsule/consumer module and OS owners retained
backend_required: Actual parent connection Token and same owner slot/generation; not closed/cleanup/quarantined or shutdown/transport error
Unique actual Delivered nr56 selector2 NEWmarker request at exact parent worker/serial/cpu; full Request equality, response still unpublished and not cancelled/completed/kernel/service
Existing actual ChildFork key/epoch/carrier metadata match request; original positive first RET published with childpid and phase FirstReturnPublished
PreLINK only: actual gate OPEN, no LINK second/busy/SEALED receipt or current control owner. Do not infer this from an arbitrary status or selector

All control bytes/geometry are routing metadata only. No new selector2 wire phase or caller-provided full-key proof is invented here. A future genuine guest Rust producer and its wire grammar must be separately source-bound.
strict_control_claim.implementation: Narrow acquire_control wrapper around actual acquire(stage0), with atomic/rechecked validation before callback. Do not call begin_link_attempt or any progress verifier/finish helper.
